content: Hiziqeeli Leemison Bessida Malaatata
GODAA qaalay taakko yiidi,
«Haysso asa nawu! Neni makkallanchcha deraa giddon daasa. Istti makkallanchcha gidida gishshas isttas ayfey dees shin demmettenna; isttas hayththi dees shin siyettenna.
Hessa gishshas asa nawu! Istti be7ishin gallas nees diza miish shiishsha ekkada goodettanaas giigetta; ne dizasoppe dendada haraso ba. Istti makkallanchcha gidikkoka akeekanaas dandayeettes.
Gallas istti xeellishin nees diza miish goodetti biza asa mala kessa; omarsika istti xeellishin di7etti biza asa mala keza.
Istti xeellishin ne keeththa godaa lukkada nees diza miish kessa.
Neni kessida miishshaa istti xeellishin gadey dhumishin ne hashen tookkada keza. Ta nena Isra7eele keeththas malata ooththida gishshas gade be7ontta mala ne sinththa kamma» gides.

Tanikka izi tana azazida mala ooththadis. Di7etti biza asa mala gallas taas diza miish shiishsha qachchada goodetti biza asa mala kessadis; omars ta keeththa godaa ta kushen lukkadis; istti xeellishin qachcha woththida miishshaa hashen tookkada dhumishin badis.
Wonteththa gallas maaladora GODAA qaalay taakko yiidi,
«Haysso asa nawu! Makkallanchcha Isra7eele asay nena, ‹Neni ooththizay aazee?› giidi nena oychchides gidennee?
Neni isttas, ‹Ubbaa Haariza GODAY ha tinbitey: Yerusalaamen diza halaqassinne Isra7eele asa kumeththassa›
Neni isttas,
«Istta giddon diza halaqay omarsara baas diza miish shiishshi tookkidi kezana; izi baqati baana mala gimbey lukettana; biittaa be7ontta mala ba ayfeso kammana.
Tani ta gite iza sinththan yeggana; izi woximadenkka oykettana; tani iza Kaladaaweta biitta Baabiloone ehana; gido attiin izi he biittaa be7ontta hayqqana.
Iza yuushon diza iza maaddizaytanne iza olanchchata ubbaa tani ubbaso piski histtana; tani istta mashshan yedeththana.
«Istta tani dereta giddoninne kawoteththa giddon laalliza wode tani GODAA gididayssa istti erana.

Istti bantti bida kawoteththata giddon bantta tuna ooso paaxana mala, tani isttafe guuththata olappe, koshappenne iita hargefe kessi ekkana mala ooththana. Tani GODAA gididayssa istti he wode erana» gides.
Yashshan Kokkoriza Nabe Malata
GODAA qaalay taakko yiidi,
«Haysso asa nawu! Ne kath kokkorashe ma; qasse ne haaththaaka gazhigazhashenne babbashe uya.

Biittan diza asaas, ‹Ubbaa Haariza GODAY Isra7eele biittan diza Yerusalaame asaas: istti bantta kath hirgishe maana; bantta haaththaaka gazhigazhishenne babbishe uyana. Heen diza asay ubbay genanchcha gidida gishshas istta biittay kayzana.
Kase isttan asi kumida katamati kayzana; biittayakka bulattana. Tani GODAA gididayssa intte he wode erana› gees» ga gides.
Asa Leemisos Goday Immida Zaaro
GODAA qaalay taakko yiidi,
«Haysso asa nawu! Isra7eele biittan, ‹Wodey aduqqides; ajjuutay ubbayka hada gidides› giidi intte tosse yootizay aazee?

Hessa gishshas isttas neni, ‹Ubbaa Haariza GODAY: tani hayssa ha tosseza diggana; istti zaareththidi hayssa ha tosseza Isra7eele biittan go7ettettenna› gees ga. Qasseka neni isttas, ‹Ajjuutay ubbayka polettana wodey matides.
Hayssafe guye Isra7eele deraa giddon wordo ajjuutaynne as muurenno oosoy deenna.

Tani GODAY haasayana koyidayssa haasayana; ta haasayda qaalaykka gam7ontta polettana; intteno makkallanchcha asatoo! Tani yootidayssa ubbaa intte layththan tani polana› gees Ubbaa Haariza GODAY» gides.
Qasseka GODAA qaalay taakko yiidi,
«Haysso asa nawu! Isra7eele asay, ‹Hayssi addezi be7iza ajjuutay buro daro layththafe guyen hananaaza; izi yootiza tinbiteykka daro layththafe guyen hananaaza› gees.
Hessa gishshas neni isttas, ‹Ubbaa Haariza GODAY: tani yootida qaalaappe gam7anaazi deenna; ta gida ubbay polettana› gees» gides.
